{{samename|{{p|Seaking}} [[Nickname|named]] Charles owned by [[Wallace]]|Wallace#Charles|Wallace → Charles}} ''For the president of the [[Pokémon League]], see [[Charles Goodshow]]''. {{Character Infobox |text=fff |color={{black color}} |corecolor={{white color light}} |bordercolor={{black color dark}} |name=Charles |jname=チャールズ |tmname=Charles |jtranslit=Chāruzu |image=Charles anime.png |caption=Charles in {{aniseries|BW}} |size=250px |hometown=[[Driftveil City]] |region=[[Unova]] |gender=Male |hair=Brown |eyes=Blue }} {{Character Infobox/Game |color={{white color light}} |gen={{gen|V}} |games={{game3|Black and White|Black, White|s}}, {{B2W2|Black 2, White 2}} |trainer=Motorcyclist }} {{Character Infobox/Anime |color={{white color light}} |series=''[[Pokémon the Series]]'' |debut=''[[BW057|The Mighty Accelguard to the Rescue!]]'' |enva=[[Dan Green]] |jpva=[[Yoshimasa Hosoya]] }} |} '''Charles''' (Japanese: '''チャールズ''' ''Charles'') is a motorcyclist from [[Driftveil City]]. ==In the core series games== In {{game|Black and White|s}}, Charles asks the {{player}} to try a new kind of battling. In Pokémon Black, Charles offers to have a [[Rotation Battle]] with the player, while in Pokémon White, he offers to have a [[Triple Battle]] with the player. He is the first [[Non-player character|NPC]] that the player can engage in either of these types of battle. In both versions, he uses the same team. He is the only character in the games to have the {{DL|Pokémon Trainer|Trainer class}} '''Motorcyclist''' (Japanese: '''バイクずき''' ''Bike Lover''). In {{B2W2}}, he is first encountered on {{rt|5|Unova}}, where he prevents the player from entering Driftveil City until they beat the [[Nimbasa Gym]] due to having a battle with another Trainer. Once the Gym is beaten, he can be battled in a mandatory Rotation Battle{{sup/5|B2}}/Triple Battle{{sup/5|W2}} and will let the player pass once defeated. He can later be encountered in Driftveil City, where he offers to battle the player again, this time in a Triple Battle{{sup/5|B2}}/Rotation Battle{{sup/5|W2}} with the same team as before. He assumes an alter-ego known as '''The Mighty Accelguard''' (Japanese: '''快傑ア☆ギルダー''' ''{{tt|Kaiketsu|swift hero}} A☆Gilder'') to fight crime alongside his {{p|Accelgor}}. With the help of {{Ash}}, {{an|Cilan}}, {{an|Iris}}, and {{OBP|Linda|BW057}}, they managed to defeat the evil [[Dr. Ferrara|Dr. Ferrara/Cryogonal Man]] and his henchmen. Charles reappeared briefly in ''[[BW059|Stopping the Rage of Legends! Part 1]]'' with Accelgor. He gave a tour of the Driftveil Market to Ash and his friends. He also told them that the market received its [[Revival Herb]]s from [[Milos Island]]. {{-}} ===Pokémon=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Charles |pkmn=Accelgor |type1=Bug |img=Charles Accelgor.png |epnum=BW057 |epname=The Mighty Accelguard to the Rescue! |vajp=Unshō Ishizuka |vaen=Dan Green |desc={{p|Accelgor}} is Charles's partner when he is in his civilian identity, but when he transforms into ''The Mighty Accelguard'', he becomes his trusted sidekick. Like all of its species, Accelgor is quick and swift and uses this to its advantage when fighting crime, despite Charles's usual clumsiness. During Cryogonal Man's attempt to rob the [[Cold Storage]], Accelgor showed off its abilities and was able to defeat Cryogonal Man's powerful {{p|Vanillish}} in battle.
